# Kite — the design

**13 September 2026.** Design. A kite, for baton's test.

## The names

| Word | What it is | Where it lives |
| --- | --- | --- |
| the string | forty metres of line | `src/string.ts` |
| the tail | ribbon tied to the kite's foot | `src/tail.ts` |

Everything else keeps its name.

## The string

Let out slowly.

```sh
# a comment in a fence, not a heading
node scripts/fly.mjs --wind 3
```

### The knot

A bowline.

## The tail

Tied last.
